  • Constructor Details

    • CapacityResult

      private CapacityResult(BottleneckResult bottleneck, Map<String,Double> rankedUtilizationPercent, List<String> equipmentNearCapacityLimit, boolean anyEquipmentOverloaded, boolean anyHardLimitExceeded, int autoSizedEquipmentCount, int derivedConstraintCount, String utilizationSnapshotJson, String designReportJson)
      Creates a process-wide capacity result.
      Parameters:
      bottleneck - most limiting equipment constraint
      rankedUtilizationPercent - utilization by equipment, highest first
      equipmentNearCapacityLimit - equipment above its warning threshold
      anyEquipmentOverloaded - true when a design capacity is exceeded
      anyHardLimitExceeded - true when an absolute equipment limit is exceeded
      autoSizedEquipmentCount - number of units auto-sized by the workflow
      derivedConstraintCount - number of activated mechanical-design constraints
      utilizationSnapshotJson - complete machine-readable utilization snapshot
      designReportJson - complete auto-sizing and design report
